name: Sunny Side Story
source:
One rainy evening, you stumble into a town that seems alive with whispers. Every conversation pulls you deeper, every choice shapes who you’ll become. Can you find belonging or will the town slip away from you?

[From [url=https://ara-draconis.itch.io/sunny-side-story-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个雨夜，你跌跌撞撞地走进一座充满窃窃私语的小镇。每一次谈话都会让你走得更远，每一次选择都会塑造你成为什么样的人。你能找到归属感吗？还是这座小镇会离你而去？

[来自[url=https://ara-draconis.itch.io/sunny-side-story-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
